Timings were exploratory and may overlap other agents. Use the final portfolio benchmark for sequential warmed runtime evidence.
All candidates are exploratory; only the frozen model enters untouched validation. Corpus cases within families are correlated.

The codec was still evolving during exploratory rounds, including the rigorous minimum-digit search bound. The reproducible model-ablation runner uses the current final codec; the final portfolio results, not these historical exploratory totals, are definitive.
